people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Rameses
people.line: Egyptian city where Israelites lived before the Exodus

people.name: Succoth
people.line: First Israelite campsite after leaving Egypt during Exodus

translations.web: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, in addition to children.
translations.bsb: The Israelites journeyed from Rameses to Succoth with about 600,000 men on foot, besides women and children.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
